stories.title: Define Specialty Match Accuracy Schema and Contract
stories.description: Define a strict response schema for specialty match accuracy including: input condition-derived NUCC codes, provider NUCC codes, match_score (0–1), match_type (exact | partial | mismatch), and explanation fields for downstream transparency.

stories.title: Implement Specialty Match Accuracy Scoring Logic
stories.description: Implement core logic that compares condition-derived NUCC taxonomy codes against provider taxonomy codes, computes normalized similarity scores, and assigns match classifications using deterministic rules aligned with specialty_service pipelines.

stories.title: Expose Specialty Match Accuracy via Evaluate Care Facade
stories.description: Integrate specialty match scoring into evaluate_care_facade so that provider evaluation responses include match_score, classification, and supporting NUCC mappings without breaking existing provider detail contracts.

stories.title: Unit and Integration Tests for Specialty Match Accuracy
stories.description: Develop unit tests validating scoring logic across exact, partial, and mismatch scenarios, plus integration tests covering end-to-end flow from specialty extraction through evaluate_care_facade output.

stories.title: Handle Multi-Specialty and Ambiguity Edge Cases
stories.description: Extend scoring logic to support providers with multiple NUCC codes, including deduplication, weighting strategies, and fallback handling for ambiguous or low-confidence condition-to-specialty mappings produced by the dual-pipeline system.
